nodes.widgets_values:
# RVK Wan Animate 2 segmented loop

1. Select your own reference image and untrimmed CFR driving video.
2. Set the segment length only on **RVK Wan Animate 2 Loop Entry**. Its output is wired to the official length input; 81 is only the default.
3. Choose a fresh relative output directory only on **RVK Wan Animate 2 Loop Entry**. It is preflighted before the model runs and wired to both Save and Finalize.
4. Finalize waits until Advance reports all frames complete, then writes final.mp4 with the source audio. Existing files are never overwritten.
5. Queue once. RVK queues the next prompt only after the previous MP4 was closed, verified, and published. Do not edit the graph while a run is active.
6. Use the **Stop RVK after current segment** button on the Entry node to prevent another segment from being queued.

The Motion Transfer subgraph remains editable. Do not duplicate it for longer videos.
nodes.title: RVK Wan Animate 2 — start here

nodes.widgets_values:
# Output and limits

- Each completed segment is an independent **silent MP4**; final.mp4 adds one audio track from the original drive video. No latent, tensor checkpoint, or permanent image sequence is written.
- Current continuation is one in-memory CPU frame and can be lost on stop/crash; completed videos remain. Restart with a new output directory.
- If all segments already exist after a restart, use finalize_existing_segments.json to create the final video without loading Wan.
- Requires the fixed compatible ComfyUI/RVK environment and `--cache-classic`; the production default RAM-pressure cache is not validated for this loop.
- The current exact window accepts an untrimmed file-backed CFR video whose time base represents frame indices exactly.
- Missing/gapped/incompatible segments, missing or short source audio, and an existing final target stop with an error; nothing is overwritten.
